title: Consolidation: The Changing Hungarian Village: From Tanya to Today

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can trace the 20th- and 21st-century transformation of Hungarian rural life from the tanya to today.
I can use compound postpositions rovására, javára, függvényében, híján, and ellenében with precision in socioeconomic essays.
I can explain the collectivization trauma, the háztáji compromise, and the post-1990 rural shifts.
I can deploy 30 specialized B2 terms for rural history, agrarian structures, and modern eco-migration.
